1... Ka5 (or any other king move)
2. h5 h4
3. h6 h3
4. h7 h2
5. h8=Q h1=Q

Now, it is Black's turn to move in the Queen and King endgame. With the initiative, I can use my new queen to attack, restrict the white king, and create winning chances. This is a far superior outcome to the drawn position arising from the immediate pawn push.
